verdict.rationale: Vercel's official onboarding flow explicitly mentions choosing a template as a first-class deploy path alongside importing a project or using the CLI, but the evidence pack lacks any detail on a template gallery/marketplace, number/variety of starters, or one-click deploy button mechanics.  Missing for 10: dedicated template marketplace evidence, breadth of use-case starters, one-click deploy button documentation, independent confirmation of template deploy experience.
